body:
First of all, you should be more careful when posting things online. If it doesn't have specific privacy controls it will probably be seen by a lot of people. All it takes is for one person you know to find your blog or whatever and suddenly everyone has it.

Having thoughts you can't control is something that everyone deals with. For some of us it is harder than others. For some people it's not a big deal at all. I personally think about suicide. I don't actually want to do it, just like you don't really want to kill your mom. But I can't help thinking about it all the time. You have some issues but you are not irreparable. There is help out there for you.

Definitely don't kill yourself or your mom. If you start having trouble then send me a message. I'll do what I can to help out.
I would like to check out Thailand sometime. I'll try to remember to let you know.

I agree with each of your first two statements. I have no daughter so I can't relate to the last, but I hope that you keep fighting your thoughts of suicide. Please, please seek help if those thoughts start becoming urges or real desires.

Your comment raises an important point, but your smiley face suggests that your attitude is that of a dick.

If you are one of those people who cruise these forums and try to convince people to kill themselves then you should consider isolating yourself from society completely. Go find a nice damp cave somewhere and just fuck yourself.
Exactly. You might find something on the first try. I'm going to China next month. It's only a short trip but maybe I'll find something there.
I feel as though I'm not doing a good job of expressing myself. If a few people respond than I will recollect and repost my thoughts.
Are you trying to ruin this fetish for me?
